meta.rl_answer: A2 Hosting is now hosting.com. Starter is $1.49 a month on a 12-month Black Friday term and renews at $13.99, 9.4 times higher. The refund window is 30 days.
meta.rl_faqs:
What is A2 Hosting? | A2 Hosting was a web host that is now called hosting.com. World Host Group bought it in January 2025, and the new name was announced in April 2025. The plans are sold under hosting.com.
Is A2 Hosting now hosting.com? | Yes. hosting.com's own blog says A2 Hosting is now hosting.com, and a2hosting.com now points to hosting.com. Plan names changed too: Startup became Starter, Drive became Plus, Turbo Boost became Pro and Turbo Max became Max.
Is A2 Hosting good? | It tests well on speed and uptime. HostingAdvice measured a 579 ms Largest Contentful Paint, and Website Planet measured 100% uptime. CNET found setup complicated and support poor, and the renewal price is high.
How much does A2 Hosting cost? | In the November 2026 Black Friday offer, Starter was $1.49 a month on a 12-month term, Pro $3.49 and Max $5.99. A 48-month Starter was $1.99. Managed WordPress plans start at $4.49 a month.
How much does A2 Hosting cost after renewal? | Starter renews at $13.99 a month, Pro at $19.99 and Max at $27.99. That is 9.4 times the 12-month Starter price. WordPress Small renews at $9.99 and Medium at $17.99.
Does A2 Hosting offer WordPress hosting? | Yes. WordPress runs on every plan with one-click install, and hosting.com sells managed WordPress plans from $4.49 a month. They include a CDN, WP Rocket, two firewalls and a 99.99% uptime guarantee.
Does A2 Hosting have a money-back guarantee? | Yes, 30 days on shared, WordPress, email and reseller hosting. It does not cover domains, renewals, VPS plans, dedicated servers or SSL certificates. A2's older anytime guarantee is gone.
How do I cancel A2 Hosting? | Contact support within 30 days of buying for a refund. After that, cancel before the renewal date, because plans renew automatically and a saved payment method may be charged three days before it.
Is there an A2 Hosting coupon code? | hosting.com's Black Friday page applies the deal automatically. One affiliate newsletter listed an extra code, so check the cart. Promotional prices apply to the first term only.
Is A2 Hosting fast? | Yes in tests. HostingAdvice measured 579 ms Largest Contentful Paint, and Website Planet measured pages loading in 0.8 to 2.2 seconds. Speeds were slower in Singapore and Australia.
Does hosting.com have phone support? | hosting.com lists 24/7/365 support. HostingAdvice found live chat replies in seconds, and CNET rated support poor. Check which channels your plan includes.
Is hosting.com better than Hostinger? | hosting.com allows 5 sites and daily backups on its entry plan against 3 sites and weekly backups on Hostinger Premium. Hostinger renews lower, at $10.99 against $13.99.

meta.rl_takeaways:
A2 Hosting is now hosting.com, renamed in 2025.
Starter is $1.49 a month on a 12-month term and renews at $13.99, 9.4 times higher (ScaleHostReview, 20 Nov 2026).
HostingAdvice measured a 579 ms Largest Contentful Paint on a cheap plan.
The money-back window is 30 days, not A2's older anytime guarantee.
meta.rl_r_verdict: hosting.com, formerly A2 Hosting, gives a very low first-year bill and good speed in tests. The renewal is much higher, so plan to move or change plans after the first term. Look elsewhere if you want low prices for years.
meta.rl_r_buy:
You want the lowest first-year bill.
You want several small sites and daily backups on one plan.
You want managed WordPress tuned by specialists.
meta.rl_r_skip:
You want a low price for years.
You are a beginner who wants easy setup and strong support.
Most of your visitors are in Asia or Australia.
meta.rl_r_pros:
The lowest first-year price among the hosts we compare.
5 sites, daily backups and free migration on the cheapest plan.
Good speed in independent tests.
Managed WordPress plans with a 99.99% uptime guarantee.
An AI website builder and an MCP server.
meta.rl_r_cons:
Renewal is 4.7 to 9.4 times higher on shared plans.
The sale price needs a 12-month or longer term.
CNET calls setup complicated and support poor.
The refund window is only 30 days.
Slower in Asia and Australia.
meta.rl_r_best: The lowest first-year bill and several small sites
meta.rl_r_method:
Our own use | We do not host our own site on hosting.com, so this is a research-based review. We did not run our own tests
Pricing and plan limits | hosting.com's plan and guarantee pages, with the Black Friday catalog prices read by ScaleHostReview (updated 20 November 2026) and checked against HostDecider, WPThinker and HostingPickers
Independent tests | HostingAdvice (November 2026), CNET (October 2026) and Website Planet
Competitor reviews | The top-ranking A2 and hosting.com reviews read for structure and questions: ScaleHostReview, HostDecider, WPThinker, HostingPickers and Bonzivo
Questions people ask | The questions the top pages answer in their headings, plus the questions people search for in Semrush, such as what A2 Hosting is, whether it is good and how to cancel
When sources disagree | We show both views and say which we used. The sale end date differs between two hosting.com pages, so we show both
Our calculations | The renewal multiples and five-year totals are our own arithmetic from hosting.com's prices
Freshness | Prices and offers are read again before this page goes live, and the page carries the date they were checked
What we did not do | We did not run our own speed or uptime test, and we did not complete a checkout. Each test number is credited to the team that measured it
